component.name: openfeature
component.title: OpenFeature
component.description: Evaluate feature flags using the OpenFeature specification with flagd.
component.label: cloud

certPath.label: common
certPath.description: Path to the TLS certificate for the remote flagd connection.

configuration.description: Default configuration shared by OpenFeature endpoints.

contextFromBody.label: common
contextFromBody.description: When true, a Map message body is used as the evaluation context. When false (default), the body is not used as context. The CamelOpenFeatureEvaluationContext header is always used regardless of this setting.

deadline.label: common
deadline.description: Deadline in milliseconds for the remote flagd connection.

defaultValue.label: common
defaultValue.description: Default value when flag evaluation fails. When evaluationType is not set, also determines the evaluation type: true or false (case-insensitive) selects boolean evaluation, any other value selects string evaluation.

evaluationType.label: common
evaluationType.description: The evaluation type. 'boolean' and 'isEnabled' use boolean evaluation (getBooleanValue). 'variant' uses string evaluation (getStringValue). When not set, the type is inferred from defaultValue. Can also be set as a path parameter in the endpoint URI, which takes precedence.

flagKey.label: common
flagKey.description: The feature flag key to evaluate. Can be overridden per message via the CamelOpenFeatureFlagKey header.

flags.label: common
flags.description: A JSON object defining feature flags in flagd format (inline). Mutually exclusive with flagsResource.

flagsResource.label: common
flagsResource.description: Camel resource URI pointing to a feature flag definition file in flagd format. Mutually exclusive with flags. When provider is also set, the provider takes precedence.

host.label: common
host.description: Remote flagd service host. When set, the flagd RPC resolver is used.

provider.label: common
provider.description: Bean reference to a custom FeatureProvider (e.g. #myProvider). When set, takes precedence over flags, flagsResource, and host.

tls.label: common
tls.description: Whether to use TLS for the remote flagd connection.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

resultProperty.label: producer
resultProperty.description: Store the evaluation result in this exchange property, preserving the original message body.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelOpenFeatureFlagKey.description: Overrides the configured flag key for this message.

CamelOpenFeatureTargetingKey.description: Sets the targeting key for the OpenFeature evaluation context.

CamelOpenFeatureEvaluationContext.description: A Map of additional evaluation context key-value pairs.

CamelOpenFeatureEvaluationType.description: Sets the evaluation type (boolean, variant, isEnabled) for the OpenFeature evaluation.

CamelOpenFeatureVariant.description: The variant name returned by the provider for this evaluation.

CamelOpenFeatureReason.description: The reason string returned by the provider for this evaluation.

CamelOpenFeatureErrorCode.description: The error code when the evaluation failed (e.g. FLAG_NOT_FOUND, TYPE_MISMATCH).

domain.description: The OpenFeature domain to bind the provider to.

evaluationType.description: The evaluation type. 'boolean' and 'isEnabled' use boolean evaluation (getBooleanValue). 'variant' uses string evaluation (getStringValue). When not set, the type is inferred from defaultValue.
